# The modules MVS pulls into the graph behind gobit's direct requires.
#
# gobit is a library (ADR 0025), so each of these is in an embedder's own
# `go list -m all`, their vulnerability scan and their legal review, whether or
# not anybody chose it. This file is not a judgement about any of them: it is
# the DIFF. A module entering the graph appears here, in a change somebody
# reviews, and the usual cause is a version bump of a direct require — which
# changes no direct line.
#
# Names only. Seventy-five sentences about somebody else's transitive graph
# would be seventy-five sentences nobody maintains, and the reasons for the
# DIRECT requires are in internal/arch/dependency_allowlist_test.go, where a new
# one cannot land without a sentence.
#
# Sorted; "#" opens a comment.
